1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 e6 3.d4 cxd4 4.Nxd4 Nc6 5..strategy: A calm developing move: the bishop heads for quick castling without blocking the d-file, so the queen keeps guarding the d4 knight. White commits to nothing yet and relies on the solid centre, hoping for a small, lasting space advantage.

Develops the last knight with a hit on e4 and completes the small centre of pawns on d6 and e6. Black can castle quickly in a solid position with both ...d5 and ...e5 in reserve as central breaks, while White has few targets.
1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 e6 3.d4 cxd4 4.Nxd4 Nc6 5..name: Sicilian Defence: Scheveningen Variation, Modern Variation
